title: I’m back – and it’s going to be a busy few months!
summary: A Business Central community blogger announces their return to writing after a two-year hiatus, sharing upcoming speaking engagements at three major conferences (Directions ASIA, DynamicsMinds, and Days of Knowledge ANZ) focused on agent automation, AI in development workflows, and licensing compliance.
key_points: The author is presenting on Business Central Agent Playground capabilities for rapid prototyping using natural language at two international conferences
A panel discussion on AI tools in AL development workflows brings together leading community developers to share practical experiences
Licensing and multiplexing risks in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform are being addressed, particularly around portals, APIs, and Power Automate flows
The author is helping organize Days of Knowledge ANZ, a new two-day community conference in Melbourne dedicated to Business Central partners and developers

quotes.text: Licensing is one of those topics people nod along to in meetings and then panic about six months later when an audit shows up.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the real-world impact and importance of understanding multiplexing risks and licensing obligations

quotes.text: I'll write when I have something worth saying, not to a schedule.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the author's renewed approach to content creation focused on quality over consistency
